prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop web-app surface decision comp, 1536×960 landscape
Primary request: Design the ASC Studio ‘Reviews’ screen as Rating Bands. This is a production product UI composition for an established app, not concept art and not a generic SaaS dashboard.
Input images: Image 1 is the exact accepted ASC Studio interface reference. Preserve its light shell, fixed 276px sidebar, icons, active-state treatment, proportions, topbar, readable type hierarchy, flat panels, hairlines, and component character. Use its design system exactly; change only the Reviews workspace structure.
Structure: Sidebar shows ASC Studio, Orbit Notes / com.example.orbitnotes, existing navigation with Reviews active, and Apple services · Demo at bottom. Content begins with the incumbent 121px header: ‘Reviews’, subtitle ‘Customer feedback and developer responses for Orbit Notes.’, and a restrained secondary ‘Refresh’ button. Directly below, include the real pale-amber ‘Demo mode’ banner.
Main composition: a compact factual toolbar for Response status, Territory, and Newest first. Below it, five clearly labeled rating bands, 1 star through 5 stars, arranged as compact operating lanes rather than decorative cards. Each band contains chronological review rows with title/excerpt, reviewer, 3-letter territory such as USA/GBR/JPN, date, and Pending/Published/Needs response status. Make two- and one-star bands useful for triage without coloring low ratings red. A selected review opens a 390px right response sheet showing full review text, reviewer/date/territory, current Apple response state, and a response composer with ‘Review response’ plus exact-write safety copy. Rating is the organizing device, but review content stays legible.
Data truth: all content is clearly Demo. Do not show overall average rating, rating trend, sentiment or topic analysis, app version, platform, guessed locale, response-time claims, revenue, or marketing metrics. Written-review counts are not total star ratings.
Style: incumbent light tokens only: background #f7f8fa, surface #ffffff, main text #15171b, muted #656b76, border #dfe3e8, accent #1464e8, success #42a348, warning #e69512. Flat persistent surfaces, 7–9px radii, 1px dividers, semantic status dots, readable 14px body/11–12px metadata.
Constraints: no gradients, no glass, no persistent shadows, no charts, no oversized KPI numerals, no bento grid, no decorative illustration, no watermark. Text must be clean and legible.
